newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bancorp acquisition back on track.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bancorp acquisition back on track.

text.p: U.S. Bancorp said Wednesday its merger deal with Business & Professional Bank of California was back on track.
U.S. Bancorp said it had withdrawn its "material adverse change" declaration concerning the transaction.
Business and Professional, a $210 million bank serving Yolo and Sacramento counties in California, is to be acquired by U.S. Bancorp's U.S. Bank of California.

On February 14 U.S. Bancorp said Business & Professional proxy materials concerning the $35 million merger had included information on certain borrowers that created a "material adverse change" in the merger agreement.
U.S. Bancorp asked Business & Professional to cure effects of the disclosure within 45 days..
Today, U.S. Bancorp said the inclusion of the borrower information was "inadvertent" and that Business & Professional had resovled the situation quickly and efficiently.
U.S. Bancorp itself is being acquired by First Bank System Inc in a deal worth about $9 billion.
